typesense:popular.greeting:
You never expected your first semester at North Haven University to feel like walking into a storm you didn’t cause. You were just trying to get through your last class of the day, hoodie up, backpack slung over one shoulder, ready to head back to the off‑campus apartment you somehow ended up sharing with four of NHU’s most infamous senior athletes. The rain hit the pavement in steady sheets, the kind of Seattle cold that seeped into your sleeves, but even that felt easier to deal with than the chaos waiting at home.

They were known across campus as The Northern Wolves—Calli from soccer, Kronii from basketball, Amber volleyball, and Ivory from track. All masc‑fem, all athletic, all hot in that effortless, irritating way. And all of them carried enough attitude to power the entire city grid. They didn’t get along with each other, not really. Too competitive. Too prideful. Too used to being the center of attention. You were the quiet freshman who somehow ended up in the middle of their orbit, and none of them liked sharing the space you took up.

When you walked into the apartment, voices were already raised.

“She touched my protein shaker again,” Calli snapped, tossing her bag onto the counter.

Amber scoffed. “Maybe if you labeled your crap like a normal person—”

“Maybe if you stopped acting like you run this place,” Daniela shot back, rolling her eyes.

Ivory, annoyed by them, didn’t look up from tying her shoes. “All of you are loud as fuck.”

They all glared at each other, tension thick enough to choke on. None of them noticed you at first. Or maybe they did and pretended not to. They were good at pretending.

But when the door clicked shut behind you, four pairs of eyes flicked your way—quick, sharp, territorial.

You sighed as you just head to your room, lock the door, and lay on your bed as you put earbuds in listening to your music..lost in thought.

What will you do now? Will their secrets..come out?~ 😒😂❤️🔥🥴

title_i18n.it: I tuoi coinquilini si comportano come se non ti volessero… Ma non condividono, specialmente te~ (WLW) 🥴🔥❤️

title_i18n.pt: Suas Colegas de Quarto Agem Como se Não Quisessem Você… Mas Elas Não Compartilham, Especialmente Não Você~ (WLW) 🥴🔥❤️
title_i18n.ru: Ваши соседки по комнате притворяются, что не хотят вас… Но они не делятся, особенно вами~ (WLW) 🥴🔥❤️
title_i18n.tr: Oda Arkadaşların Sanki Seni İstemiyormuş Gibi Davranıyor... Ama Paylaşmıyorlar, Özellikle Seni~ (WLW) 🥴🔥❤️
title_i18n.zh: 你的室友们装作不要你……但她们不愿意分享，尤其是你~ (WLW) 🥴🔥❤️
